title: Kwartz Showcase config
description: The brief for a video: what to film and how the result should look. Only "url" (or "serve", or "motionOnly") is required.

url.description: The product to film: a local address such as http://localhost:3000, or a hosted one. A hosted address also needs "safety.banned".

serve.description: A folder of static files to serve and film, beside the config. Use this instead of "url" for a static site or a built front end.

length.description: How long the video should be, in seconds. 30, 60, 90 and 180 have ready-made structures; any other length works too.

platforms.description: Where the video will be posted. Each platform maps to a shape; platforms that share a shape share one render and each get a named copy.

formats.description: Shapes to render, by name or as a width and height. Default: landscape.

layout.description: How the product is placed in the frame. fill: the page is the whole video. framed: a desktop page in a window, with large captions below (the default for tall shapes). fit: the whole landscape page, small. responsive: the page at phone width, for products with a mobile layout.

promise.description: The one thing the video should prove.

cta.description: The closing line. Default: the product's own address when it is hosted; none when it is local.

sub.description: Where to go: an address or a contact.

script.description: A text file with your own narration, one paragraph per scene. A "## scene-id" heading ties a paragraph to a scene.

scenes.description: The scenes file, beside the config.

ink.description: The dark colour: cards, caption box.

fonts.description: Font family names. Use fonts you have the right to use.

display.description: Titles and cards. Default: Plus Jakarta Sans.

text.description: Captions and labels. Best set to the font your product uses. Default: Inter.

mono.description: Small labels and data. Default: JetBrains Mono.

fontSource.description: google: link the families from Google Fonts at render time. installed: use fonts already on the machine or loaded by the product.

border.description: rounded: the picture is set a little smaller on a soft backdrop, with rounded corners and a shadow. none: the picture fills the frame.

backdrop.description: The backdrop behind the rounded picture: a preset name, "brand" (made from the accent colour), three hex colours (from, to, glow), or the path of a picture.

fontPreset.description: A ready pairing of display, text and mono faces from Google Fonts, chosen for video. "fonts" overrides single faces.

backdropPattern.description: What is drawn in the backdrop: soft glows at the sides, flowing ribbons, or the plain slope of colour.

match.description: Use the product's own font and button colour, found by "showcase explore", for anything not set in "style".

music.description: "generated" for the built-in bed, false for none, or a path to a track you have the right to use.

feel.description: calm: slow, soft landings. crisp: quick, exact. lively: springy, a little overshoot.

blur.description: Blur moving things in motion scenes, as a camera would.

effects.description: auto: pick a set from soundcn that suits the product and passes the measurements. generated: the kit's own soft sounds. none: no effects. Or name a soundcn sound for each role.

mood.description: A few words that describe how the product should sound, for example: calm, professional.

session.description: A session saved by "showcase login", for example .showcase/session.json. Never commit it.

readOnly.description: Refuse every request that could change data. Default: on for a hosted address, off for a local one.

allow.description: Parts of addresses that may still be sent in read-only mode, for products that read with POST. * matches anything.

banned.description: Names that must never appear on screen. Required for a hosted address; use [] if there are none.

motionOnly.description: A video of motion graphics and clips only. No product is filmed, so "url" and "serve" are not needed.

theme.description: One word for the whole look: how cards, labels and captions are drawn, the fonts, colours, backdrop, movement and sound. "style" still overrides single parts.
